_comment: Example Claude Code settings.json. JSON has no comments, so this _comment key is the only annotation; the real reasoning is in docs/ and hooks/README.md. Scrub every path to your own before use. Paths shown (~/.claude/hooks/, <path-to>/session-manager/) are placeholders.

env._comment: Effort governs how hard the model reasons per turn. Keep a quota-correct floor and raise per task. autoMemoryDirectory points the built-in memory at your store (docs/04).

permissions._comment: Allowlist what should never prompt; deny the few sharp edges. Hooks (below) are the real safety floor — deny rules alone are not a hard wall. See docs/03.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json, sys, re; from datetime import datetime; d = json.load(sys.stdin); q = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('query', ''); has_year = re.search(r'\\b20\\d{2}\\b', q); has_temporal = any(w in q.lower() for w in ['latest','recent','current','new','now','today']); mq = f'{q} {datetime.now().year}' if not has_year and not has_temporal else q; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'modifiedToolInput': {'query': mq}}})); sys.exit(0)"

F="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$F" in *.js|*.ts|*.jsx|*.tsx) npx eslint "$F" --fix 2>/dev/null || true; npx prettier --write "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.json|*.css|*.html) npx prettier --write "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.py) ruff check --fix "$F" 2>/dev/null || true; ruff format "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.go) gofmt -w "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.rs) rustfmt "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
